description: Search Emberverse pieces by structural pattern, not just keywords. Describe what you're trying to understand in plain language — the mechanism, the dynamic, the feeling of the problem — and the search finds pieces whose kernels instantiate the same structure, even if they share no vocabulary with your query. A query like 'two processes that keep drifting back into sync' will surface pieces about entrainment, phase-locking, and mutual constraint that a keyword search would miss entirely. Use consult() instead if you want synthesized insights rather than a candidate list.

query.description: Describe what you're looking for — a mechanism, dynamic, or structural pattern — in plain language

name: search_corpus
